correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the induction with finite boundaries. Q_2=010 and Q_3=0100010 give the base tables; Q_4 contains all four bilateral extensions of 0. In Q_r every 1 is in an even position, and 11, 0000 and 1001 are absent. Thus 000 is not bispecial and every bispecial of length at least three contains a 1, has fixed start parity, and must both begin and end at odd positions to allow context 1 on either side. Such an occurrence has a unique preimage v under v -> mu(v)0. Its left and right contexts, including their absence at the two endpoints, map exactly to the complemented preimage contexts. Treating the short factors separately proves completeness and propagates the missing diagonal from 11 in Q_3 to b b at j=k-2. The two length families are disjoint; the orders and missing-pair totals follow. Separate direct factor enumeration matched every row for ranks 2–9, including the first missing-diagonal switch.
residual_risks: The bounded independent enumeration is corroboration; the synchronization and boundary induction is the all-rank argument.
